Name: Fuhrländer FL2500 2.5MW wind turbine dataset
Summary: Five-minute SCADA statistics of 78 sensors and alarm events from five Fuhrländer FL2500 wind turbines over 2012 to 2014, stored as JSON.
Description:
This dataset covers five Fuhrländer FL2500 wind turbines of 2.5 MW, with three years of data each from 2012 to 2014. Alejandro Blanco Martínez compiled it from a SCADA system he worked with and published it on Figshare with Jordi Solé-Casals and Pere Marti-Puig in 2024.

Every five minutes the data report the minimum, maximum, mean and standard deviation of 78 sensors, a total of 312 variables, stored as JSON in a dataset folder. Alarm events come with the system, the subsystem and a short description.

Functions for R, MATLAB and other languages turn the raw JSON into a table with one variable per column and one five-minute entry per row. The MATLAB code also includes an extreme learning machine classifier by Pere Marti-Puig as a prediction example.
